nom: BOBBI BROWN Soothing Cleansing Oil & Makeup Remover

avis.texte: I am 45 and have sensitive skin, prone to breakouts and reactive to many ingredients. Based on reviews I was hesitant to try this, but I am so glad I did. It has a lavender scent, which I love and it dissipates pretty quickly. I wear waterproof mascara and this melts it off quickly with no irritation, I also use it to remove foundation/concealer, and it works beautifully. Be sure to follow the directions, as emulsifying after applying is key. I do use a probiotic cleanser after using this, so it only ever sits overnight on my eyes, and has not caused breakouts there or milia, which I am prone to. Again, I credit this to following the directions... by emulsifying with water, most anything moderately pore-clogging rinses right off.

avis.titre: Smooth bump free skin- new staple
avis.texte: This is the best oil cleanser. It definitely clears pores & lifts impurities. I have acne/clogged pores that causes pimples & texture. This drastically improved my skin after 3 nights. I was wondering why my skin was getting so clear. It's this.

Too bad they reformulated this product into a foul smelling and terrible performing oil. Does not cleanse so well, nor smell as fantastic as the original. Very disappointed with this, I am so glad I got just the travel size to try. Please bring back the original formula!!
It made my skin break out super bad i looked up the ingredients and it has pore clogging ingredients im currently trying to clear the break outs it gave me

avis.titre: The only thing I wash my face with!!
avis.texte: I'm normally a cheap girly and I can't justify spending that much money on a project to just wash my face with, but I have absolutely no acne ever since using this!! It has absolutely no smell to it which is a bonus. And trust me I have tried many many products and nothing else has worked this good!!

This is my holy grail face wash. I noticed that the formula has changed. I haven't seen any differences in my skin, but the smell is not pleasant. Overall, I love this cleanser and hope it will still work for my skin.

This is fine for the 1st step of removing makeup, including non-waterproof mascara, if you don't have sensitive skin. The scent is really strong, and I just wish brands would leave it out entirely. It makes my face very red. And it is very expensive. There are less expensive, equally effective oil cleansers with less fragrance, and I'll go with those next time.
Love this for removing my makeup! It's easy to use and leaves my skin feeling moisturized, never greasy/oily. It's my preferred choice when removing my makeup now.

I just started using this cleansing oil for a month now. I use it as part of my doible cleansing night routine. And the inprovement ive seen with my pores and blackhead/sebaceous on my nose is remarkable. I have a 14 year old aon who is struggling with blackheads/sebaceous i will be having him begin this journey to start clearing up his tzone area as well. Dont let the negative reviews scare you. It works for me. Try it out and if you dont like it you can always retrun it. Ulta has such an amzing return policy.

While this is a nice cleanser it did not work for me and seriously irritated my skin, leaving my entire face red for hours. I'm not sure if it was an allergic reaction considering I used cleansers with similar ingrefients in the past with no problem. I wouldn't recommend this product if you have sensitive skin.
